Example

void *usb_cdc_driver_data_pipe_open(uint8_t ep_addr, T_USB_CDC_DRIVER_ATTR attr, uint8_t pending_req_num, USB_CDC_DRIVER_CB cb)

Open CDC data pipe.

usb_cdc_driver.h

Example

Please refer to How to Implement USB CDC Interface.

参数:

  • ep_addr -- The endpoint address.

  • attr -- The pipe attribute of T_USB_CDC_DRIVER_ATTR.

  • pending_req_num -- Supported pending request number.

  • cb -- The application callback of USB_CDC_DRIVER_CB, which will be called after data transmission is completed.

返回:

CDC handle

int usb_cdc_driver_data_pipe_close(void *handle)

Close CDC data pipe.

usb_cdc_driver.h

参数:

handle -- Return value of usb_cdc_driver_data_pipe_open.

返回:

Refer to rtl_errno.h.
